howItWorks.title: How Smart Dream works
howItWorks.subtitle: Get to know the platform workflow from sign up to premium boosting.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Sign up with your first name, last name, phone number, email and a password. You must accept the Terms & Conditions. Your account is then sent for admin approval.
howItWorks.step2Desc: An admin reviews your details and approves your account. Until then, you cannot log in. Contact the admin on WhatsApp to speed things up.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Once logged in, add up to 20 Adsterra ad-viewer links from the Links page.
howItWorks.step4Desc: On the home feed you see other users' links. Liking a link views their ad for a few seconds. To keep receiving likes you must keep giving likes: an active user gives at least the configured number of likes within the configured window. Your links appear to others only while you are active.
howItWorks.step5Desc: See how many likes you gave and received today and in total.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Boosted puts your links in front of everyone, and Auto-Like automates liking for you. Contact the admin on WhatsApp to activate either.
howItWorks.step7Desc: Give the required number of likes on the Boosted page to earn free Auto-Like minutes.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to commonly asked questions about the platform.
faq.a1: Your account is waiting for admin approval. Contact the admin on WhatsApp to activate it.
faq.q2: How many links can I add?
faq.q3: Why aren't my links being shown to others?
faq.a3: You become active by giving likes within the active window. While inactive, your links are not shown. Keep giving likes to keep receiving.
faq.q4: How long until a link I liked reappears?
faq.a4: A link you have liked is hidden from you for 8 hours, then it can reappear.
faq.a5: A premium feature that places your links in front of everyone on the Boosted page. Contact the admin to activate it.
faq.a6: A premium feature that automates liking on the home feed. You can also earn free Auto-Like minutes by giving likes on the Boosted page.
faq.q7: How do I pay for premium features?
faq.a7: Payments are handled offline. Tap the activate button on the Premium page and contact the admin on WhatsApp.
faq.q8: How do I edit or delete my links?
faq.a8: Go to the Links page from the sidebar. You can edit the title or URL of your links, or delete them anytime using the edit/delete options on each link card.
faq.q9: What should I do if my links are blocked or not working?
faq.a9: Ensure your links are valid Adsterra ad-viewer URLs and do not violate platform policies. If a link is blocked or you face issues, contact the admin directly on WhatsApp for assistance.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By creating an account you agree to the following:
terms.rule1: You will use the platform honestly and will not use automated tooling outside of the official Auto-Like feature.
terms.rule2: Likes represent genuine ad views. Attempts to fake views may result in account suspension.
terms.rule3: Your account is reviewed and approved manually by an admin before it becomes active.
terms.rule4: Premium features (Boosted, Auto-Like) are activated offline via the admin and may expire based on the selected plan.
terms.rule5: You are responsible for keeping your account credentials safe.
terms.outro: You must accept these terms to create an account.
